reuse.why: Adds shared guard helpers, but the Fintegra link and download are hand-copied from the Akahu versions, and the holder-unlink reset re-writes unlinkAccount's field reset instead of extracting it.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a seventh copy of the per-provider link body, downloadFintegraTransactions is a compacted copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, the account-reset block copies unlinkAccount's update, and the two guard calls are repeated in all six handlers.

placement.why: Handlers and downloader sit in the right modules, but linking rules are defined in app.ts rather than beside findOrCreateBank in accounts/link.ts, and a function named assert... performs the take-over write.

scope.why: Mostly focused, with an incidental widening of DbAccount.account_sync_source that leaves out the new 'fintegra' source.

maintainability.why: Every linking rule must be wired into six copied handlers by hand, and assertBankAccountNotLinked silently mutating another account behind a boolean flag is surprising to a maintainer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link routine existed to bypass; all handlers call the new guards.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is downloadAkahuTransactions compacted (destructured response, inlined objects), and the reset in assertBankAccountNotLinked copies unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount block under a different function.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gained replaceExistingLink and a branch that unlinks the holder instead of throwing, turning an assertion into a mutating operation; it is called (with assertAccountIsOpen) from each of six copied link handlers.
